ResearchProjectDef.label: skeleton recall codes
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fragments of the old empire's command codes still drift through the mechband. Pieced together and broadcast from a modified mechband antenna, they wake the skeleton legions that went dormant when the empire fell.\n\nWhatever answers has been alone in the dark for a very long time. Its protocols are corrupted and it will attack anything it finds, but a skeleton brought down intact can be interrogated and reprogrammed to serve the colony.

ResearchProjectDef.label: skeleton repair kits
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how the ancient skeleton frames were patched up in the field, and make repair kits for them at the skeleton workbench. Skeletons do not heal on their own; a crafter with a repair kit can work on a damaged skeleton until it is whole.

ResearchProjectDef.label: skeleton repair beds
ResearchProjectDef.description: Rebuild the repair cradles the old empire kept for its skeletons. A powered repair bed slowly mends a skeleton lying in it, scars included. Its control system needs an AI persona core.

ResearchProjectDef.label: skeleton fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reverse-engineer the old empire's skeleton parts. Unlocks the skeleton workbench, where crafters make motors, robotic components and skeleton muscle, and assemble them into replacement limbs, optical sensors and audio receivers for skeletons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced skeleton parts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Rebuild the old empire's better limb patterns: the hard-wearing KLR limbs, heavy industrial limbs and precise steady limbs, and the AI core that houses a skeleton's mind.
